changeSet.comment: Update all shifts with NULL created_at or created_by fields. Sets created_at to current timestamp and created_by to HQ admin user ID (shailesh.parkhi@joshsoftware.com). This migration updates all existing shift records that were created before the audit columns were added.
changeSet.sql: -- Update all shifts with NULL created_at or created_by UPDATE shift SET created_at = COALESCE(created_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), created_by = COALESCE(created_by, (SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'shailesh.parkhi@joshsoftware.com' LIMIT 1)) WHERE created_at IS NULL OR created_by IS NULL;
